summary: The Android camera manager clears its Activity reference when the current owner is destroyed and rejects attempts to attach an already-destroyed owner.
reasoning: At the July 1 history boundary, NodeApp already retained a process-wide runtime and the camera manager already stored its lifecycle owner without clearing it on destruction. The September capture-isolation change added cancellation for active captures and left idle ownership as it was. The older path history stopped at a missing object, so I could not establish when the camera manager first began outliving its Activity.
